primary.title: Foreign assets disclosure scheme 2026: What taxpayers with unreported overseas crypto should know
primary.summary: FAST-DS 2026 allows eligible taxpayers to voluntarily disclose certain undisclosed foreign assets and income. But can it cover unreported overseas crypto? The rules depend on where the crypto is held, how it was acquired and whether the taxpayer meets the scheme’s conditions.
